Q: Calculating length in UTF-8 of Java String without actually encoding it A:

Starting in JDK 27 (released September 15, 2026), you can use String#encodedLength(Charset) for this:

"some really long string".encodedLength(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)

Q: Facebook Ads API how to get all campaigns that are in draft status A:

Draft campaigns created in the Ads Manager UI do not appear in the Graph API because they do not exist as API database objects until they are published.

Why Drafts Don't Show Up in the API

  • UI Drafts are Local/Ephemeral: When you create a draft in the Ads Manager web interface, Meta stores that data in a temporary session and browser cache layer. No Campaign node or actual database record is generated until you click Publish.

  • DRAFT is not an API effective_status: The Graph API only indexes published entities within Meta's servers. There is no DRAFT status or filter available to query via HTTP requests.

How to Handle Drafts in Your Workflow

  • If created via the Web UI: Click Publish in Ads Manager to make the campaign visible to Postman. Make sure the campaign switch is set to Paused before publishing so it won't go live or spend budget.

  • If created via Postman (API): Sending a POST request to /campaigns with "status": "PAUSED" creates the record immediately in Meta's database in a paused state, which serves as the direct API equivalent of a draft.

Q: how can i record and play my voice in real time using c/c++ A:

you record 3 buffers 20 milliseconds each. you play with gap in 40 milliseconds. So in the one moment of the time you are recording into 1 buffer, 2nd is at the rest (to complete all switching mechanisms), 3rd is playing. gap in 40 milliseconds is hard to notice.

Q: Find Command with multiple file extensions A:

an other solution is to use -regex option:
find /root/TEST/Images -type f -regex '.+\.\(jpg\|JPG\|png\)$'
I also added -type f to only search files (not folders)

Be careful to not forget any escape character to . () and |

Q: How to check my windows server is virtual machine or physical machine A:

You can try to use the following PowerShell script, it utilizes WMI to find out if machine is virtual machine or physical machine.

gwmi -q "select * from win32_computersystem"

Certainly, you can use C# code to query WMI too. The output of script above will be like following:

Domain:   ...
Manufacturer: Microsoft Corporation
Model: Virtual Machine
Name : .....
....
